holisticNarrative.summary:
The evidence base for MedPointe is unusually thin: one two-page PDF explains UI steps for exporting chart documents via C62, and a help-page screenshot confirms that this is the only export document publicly posted in the relevant section. The workflow itself is straightforward and includes both single-patient and batch chart export entry points, which is a meaningful operational positive.

The limiting factor is semantic transparency. The artifact does not describe C62 internals, fields, relationships, value sets, keys, or representative payload content. Because MedPointe is positioned as an integrated ambulatory EHR plus billing/RCM platform, this missing structure creates substantial uncertainty about whether full designated-record-set EHI (especially structured clinical and patient-specific financial records) is practically portable. In migration terms, this is a high-risk documentation posture: export exists, but interpretability and completeness cannot be validated from available primary evidence.
